description: Find US filers related to a company using SEC's own SIC classification -- no curation and no model. Covers every industry with a US filer, including ones no curated map reaches. It gives no value-chain position and no non-US participants: for those prefer industry_brief where a map exists. Peer matching is by company name and is a starting universe, not an index membership list.

cik.description: Anchor company CIK. Resolve one with list_us_universe.

name: industry_peers
title: Find Industry Peers
